summary: Added a multi-page standalone ArcRho user manual that can be opened directly from the frontend folder.
details: The manual now uses separate topic pages for shell navigation, project setup, project instance workflows, datasets, DFM, Result Selection, Workflow, macros, ArcBot, Arcode, Python API, Excel add-in usage, ResQ migration, and troubleshooting.
Embedded HTML UI examples use sample data, highlighted controls, and simulated interaction animations to show common ArcRho screens without requiring a running app.
